title_en: Tobacco Leaf Tax Law of the People's Republic of China

articles.content_en: Article 1 Within the territory of the People's Republic of China, units that purchase tobacco leaves in accordance with the provisions of the Tobacco Monopoly Law of the People's Republic of China shall be taxpayers of the tobacco leaf tax. Taxpayers shall pay the tobacco leaf tax in accordance with the provisions of this Law.
Article 2 Tobacco leaves as mentioned in this Law refer to flue-cured tobacco leaves and sun-cured or air-cured tobacco leaves.
Article 3 The tax basis for the tobacco leaf tax shall be the total amount of consideration actually paid by the taxpayer for the purchase of tobacco leaves.
Article 4 The tax rate for the tobacco leaf tax shall be 20 percent.

Article 5 The amount of tax payable for the tobacco leaf tax shall be calculated by multiplying the total amount of consideration actually paid by the taxpayer for the purchase of tobacco leaves by the tax rate.

Article 6 The tobacco leaf tax shall be collected and administered by the tax authorities in accordance with this Law and the relevant provisions of the Law of the People's Republic of China on the Administration of Tax Collection.
Article 7 Taxpayers shall declare and pay the tobacco leaf tax to the competent tax authorities in the place where the tobacco leaves are purchased.
Article 8 The time when the obligation to pay the tobacco leaf tax arises shall be the date on which the taxpayer purchases the tobacco leaves.
Article 9 The tobacco leaf tax shall be assessed on a monthly basis, and taxpayers shall declare and pay the tax within 15 days from the end of the month in which the tax obligation arises.

Article 10 This Law shall come into force as of July 1, 2018. The Interim Regulations on Tobacco Leaf Tax of the People's Republic of China promulgated by the State Council on April 28, 2006 shall be abolished simultaneously.
